description: Use this when an agent or user is about to buy, swap into, or list an ERC-20 token and needs to know if it is safe. EVM token safety check on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon or BNB Chain: 0-100 safety score, plain-English verdict (safe / caution / danger) and flags. Runs a real buy -> sell swap simulation (eth_simulateV1, nothing broadcast) against the token's main pool to catch honeypots and measure buy/sell tax, plus verified source (Sourcify), owner/renounced, mint/pause/blacklist/tax-setter/trading-switch functions, upgradeable proxy, liquidity and pair age (DexScreener), 24h buys vs sells, and holder concentration. Partial results with per-source status instead of failing. Not charged on error. Returns JSON with: ok, data, sources, fetched_at, cache_age_s. Price: $0.02 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-token-safety

chain.description: chain; default eth (aliases: ethereum, arb, op, matic, bnb, chain ids)
